subject.title: [Feature]: Add agent-initiated sticker sending to Feishu channel

question: Should OpenClaw's Feishu plugin add a supported agent sticker action, and if so should it use a verified Feishu discovery API or only administrator-provided sticker assets?
rationale: The reported gap is real at the documented capability level, but the permanent sticker-selection and asset-access contract determines the user-facing action, credentials, configuration surface, and maintenance boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded Feishu action
options.body: Approve a Feishu-plugin implementation after verifying the upstream API and define one supported asset-source policy with focused tests and documentation.

options.title: Use configured sticker assets only
options.body: Limit the first version to administrator-provided Feishu file tokens or assets, avoiding an unverified store-search dependency at the cost of less automatic discovery.

options.title: Defer pending upstream support
options.body: Keep the request open but do not add a new action until Feishu exposes a stable, bot-usable discovery and asset-sharing contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded Feishu action
recommendation.body: Approve a Feishu-plugin implementation after verifying the upstream API and define one supported asset-source policy with focused tests and documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: Available Feishu-area history provides the strongest visible signal for an item that requires a product and ownership decision rather than a mechanical repair.
